name: hdbt_subtheme
author: Druid

scripts.typecheck:warn: npm run typecheck || echo 'Warning: TypeScript errors found'
scripts.build: npm run typecheck:warn && npm run lint && node theme-builder.mjs && npm run postbuild
scripts.postbuild: mkdir -p dist/icons && cp src/icons/*.svg dist/icons/ && sed -i '' '/sourceMappingURL/d' dist/css/tiny-slider/tiny-slider.css || true
scripts.lint: npm run lint:scss && npm run lint:js
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:scss && npm run format:js
